[[groovy-fx-group-methods]]
== Utility Methods

These are explicit methods (not node factories) available on `SceneGraphBuilder`:

[cols="2,4", options="header"]
|===
| Method | Description

| `fx`
| Runs a closure on the JavaFX application thread and waits for it, starting the toolkit if necessary.

| `fxLater`
| Schedules a closure on the JavaFX application thread and returns immediately.

|===
